craft_notes: Sthāyin: renouncing kin for the Lifter. Device: end-dash→comma (kin dismissed softly, landing released). Rejected: 'relatives' modernising bandhu — kept kin. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Kinsmen avail what, comrades, overlords the like,
my Master, in all stations thou that landest from birth's brine.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kim anyair bandhubhiḥ kiṃ ca suhṛdbhiḥ svāmibhis tathā sarvasthāne mameśa tvaṃ ya uddhartā bhavārṇavāt

reads_against.argmap: What with other kin, what with friends and masters likewise.; In every place, my lord, you lift from the becoming-ocean. → No kin or master; you alone lift everywhere.
c1_essence: Kin, comrades, patrons nothing; you haul from birth-sea everywhere.
reads_against.l2: Kinsmen avail what, comrades what, patrons what? My lord, in every strait it is you who hauls us off the sea of birth.
